title: How supply and demand set the price

steps.title: Demand curve
steps.say: Buyers want more of a good when its price is low, so demand slopes down from left to right.

ops.text: How supply and demand set the price

steps.title: Supply curve
steps.say: Sellers offer more when the price is high, so supply slopes up. Where the two curves cross is the market's equilibrium.

steps.title: Equilibrium
steps.say: The curves cross at price 5 and quantity 5. At that price the amount buyers want equals the amount sellers offer.

steps.title: Why the price settles there
steps.say: If the price were above 5, sellers would offer more than buyers want, a surplus that pushes the price down. If it were below 5, buyers would want more than is offered, a shortage that pushes it up.

steps.title: Quiz: supply falls
steps.say: Supply falls by 2, so the supply curve moves left. Drag the dot to where you think the new equilibrium is.
